contractRegistry.transferConcern: Return to S1 is only a candidate scene re-entry, not an assumed chronological route

deferred.reason: S4 is the authorized transfer of S3; separate S4 origin needs distinct approved transfer and independent contract

intentModel.dualRolePolicy: Explicit intent and origin scope decide whether S2 is local (S2-origin) or transfer (S1-origin); any ambiguity fails closed

scopeModel.authBoundary: NICK is a display identity; real backend authentication is separately required

proofPolicy.questionFunction: Recognize WHY as causal gap; contrast with HOW as concept, not required HOW menu or prior HOW assessment
proofPolicy.local: Observed independent answer to situated WHY, not listening or grammatical reformulation
proofPolicy.transfer: Observed independent reason in approved alternate scene; same skill different causal context; may be attempted before local proof but cannot close Pass Contract without all requirements
proofPolicy.counting: Each occurrence evaluated once in exact learner × skill × language × origin scope; no dual assignment
proofPolicy.progress: Only existing canonical Evidence and Pass Contract can advance 0/3→3/3
proofPolicy.contextualScore: 0/4 contextual adequacy remains separate from canonical 0/3 progress

pedagogy.existence: THERE + TO BE / THERE IS / THERE ARE is a separate EXISTENCE function, not WHY authority
pedagogy.activePilotSubset: PRESENT / AFFIRMATIVE / EN-ES-PT contextual authoring reference only; grammar modes do not automatically become reason-answer evidence

adoptionGates: Approve local and transfer tasks/distractors and independent learner actions EN/ES/PT
Approve per-origin contract changes and conflict rule when S2 has dual roles
Source-backed specification independently authoring HOW contrast without requiring HOW QW menu
Demonstrate snapshot retention on QW/language/Experience switches
Cross-origin, cross-language and cross-NICK fail-closed tests
Actual browser EN/ES/PT desktop/portrait/landscape, speech and Word Path/PATITA provenance
Human homologation then separate runtime authorization
